d: Deep purple hair is styled in a high, sweeping ponytail with long, sharp bangs framing a face of a mature teenager. The eyes are a glowing cyan with a focused, sharp expression. A slender, athletic build is clad in a dark charcoal and bronze metallic bodysuit featuring a breastplate, silver pauldrons, and matching armored gauntlets, accented by a burgundy scarf wrapped around the neck. Signature details include bronze-rimmed goggles worn on the forehead and a silver-bladed sword with a gold crossguard held in the hand.
